rubrics.justification: Accurately identifies a day-4 cavitating morula/very early blastocyst with limited blastocoel, indistinct ICM, and sparse/irregular TE. Minor overreach in assigning Gardner-style ICM/TE grades from this image and no comment on zona thinning.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve markers, BMI, prior live birth, semen parameters, endometrium, smoking, and transfer timing with embryo morphology to frame prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with prognosis appropriately balancing favorable patient factors against only fair embryo quality. Minor issue: clinical pregnancy estimate slightly exceeds implantation estimate range.

Recommendations are broadly consistent with IVF practice: SET at age 29, caution about routine PGT-A, smoking cessation, and avoiding low-evidence add-ons. Slight limitation is use of Gardner-equivalent grading on a day-4 embryo.

Provides clear practical next steps for current transfer and future cycles, including SET, lifestyle optimization, luteal support adherence, review of embryology progression, consideration of blastocyst culture, and targeted further workup if failures recur.
